mapper.select: SELECT * FROM device_fault_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY fault_time DESC

SELECT d.device_name, COUNT(f.id) AS faultCount, MAX(f.fault_time) AS lastFaultTime FROM device_fault_record f JOIN device_info d ON f.device_id = d.id WHERE f.fault_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY d.id, d.device_name ORDER BY faultCount DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_fault_record(device_id, fault_type, fault_desc, fault_time, resolved_time, resolved_by, created_at) VALUES(#{deviceId}, #{faultType}, #{faultDesc}, #{faultTime}, #{resolvedTime}, #{resolvedBy}, NOW())
